text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
She knows exactly how to move every
part of her
body—an indispensable skill
for a performer!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Maybe we could make use
of that
stage set... I'll ask the crew!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Light Hello seems to be greatly moved
and
inspired after watching
<chrname>
train.
